race.description: Premier Horses Molteuno & Rileycat Class 3 Hcp (Bm66)
race.comment: MIDNIGHT MOOSE (1) was plain fresh but bounced back in a big way last start on the Acton when leading all the way. The form has been solid out of that race and while he carries the big weight here, he's a classy horse on the rise. Can sit handy again and land the knockout blow. DANCER'S DELIGHT (3) won well fresh before flying late last start over 1100m in some strong late splits. Likely to get back again, but the 1200m journey now is a big tick for him and if he can run up to the splits, he'll be right in the finish. XSPIRITOUS (8) missed narrowly two back before dropping back in trip last start and finding them a bit quick. She is better suited out to this trip now and can put her best foot forward. CURLY BEND (10) is better than she showed last time out and can bounce back to her best. I AM BRAVE (9) won't be far away with the blinkers on first time and dropping to country level.
